headline: Central Fronts Erupt as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Since the 04:44 edition the war has intensified across several corridors. Dead Lands remains the bloodiest sector, with both sides’ casualty rates now accelerating past 1,400 and 1,850 per hour respectively and ten ownership flips in the last day. Endless Shore has surged to twenty‑one flips in twenty‑four hours; Colonial losses are climbing but the two‑hour trend shows a slight cooling, while Warden losses continue to accelerate. Farranac Coast added eight flips and both factions’ casualties are rising sharply. Linn Mercy has become the most active region on the map, recording twenty‑ nine captures or losses in the past day and pushing each side’s hourly casualties above 2,500. Fisherman’s Row, quiet in the last two hours, still logged fifteen flips yesterday and its casualty rates are now accelerating for both armies. Marban Hollow continues to see eight flips with casualties above 1,000 per hour for each side. Conversely, Drowned Vale and many rear‑area hexes show no recent captures and flat casualty trends, indicating a lull on those fronts.
